description: Source code for managing file descriptor events in the lighttpd web server, including functions for registering, unregistering, and handling fdnode events.

methods.name: fdnode_init
methods.description: Initializes a new fdnode structure with allocated memory.

methods.name: fdnode_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an fdnode.

methods.name: fdevent_register
methods.description: Registers a new file descriptor with the event system.

methods.name: fdevent_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a file descriptor from the event system.

methods.name: fdevent_sched_close
methods.description: Schedules a file descriptor to be closed.

methods.name: fdevent_fdnode_event_unsetter_retry
methods.description: Retries unsetting an event on a file descriptor in case of temporary errors.

methods.name: fdevent_fdnode_event_unsetter
methods.description: Unsets an event on a file descriptor.

methods.name: fdevent_fdnode_event_setter_retry
methods.description: Retries setting an event on a file descriptor in case of temporary errors.

methods.name: fdevent_fdnode_event_setter
methods.description: Sets an event on a file descriptor.
